title: trainingOptions
summary: Create a training options compatibility object.
description: `trainingOptions(solver)` creates host metadata for common Deep Learning Toolbox training configuration.
behaviors: Common options such as `MaxEpochs`, `MiniBatchSize`, `InitialLearnRate`, `Shuffle`, `Verbose`, `Plots`, and `ExecutionEnvironment` are stored as properties.
This object is consumed as metadata in this slice; full optimizer execution remains in the training/autodiff queue.

example.input:
opts = trainingOptions(solver)
opts = trainingOptions(solver, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Training option construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
